topic.title: Environmental Impact Assessment / Screening / Scoping / Environmental Statement
topic.source_contract: project description, schedule classification, screening opinion, scoping opinion, competent experts, baseline, alternatives, likely significant effects, mitigation hierarchy, residual and cumulative effects, environmental statement, consultation, decision, conditions, construction and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A screening request is not a screening opinion.
A scoping opinion is not an Environmental Statement.
An Environmental Statement is not planning permission.
Proposed mitigation is not evidence of implementation.
Consultation responses are not a final EIA conclusion.
A consent is not evidence that conditions were discharged.
Construction activity is not measured post-project performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact project, EIA decision, mitigation and monitoring evidence.
